project.name: osgi/runtime/cellar-cipher-age
project.description: The age realisation of the seed-broker CellarCipher seam: a pure-Java, multi-recipient seal of the cellar's SEALED entries, backed by jagged (age over the JDK JCA) through jagged-wrap. Reveals with the operator's age identity from SOPS_AGE_KEY (the same identity that signs commits and reveals sops — ssh-to-age of the github-signing key), seals to the age recipients in RKE2LAB_CELLAR_RECIPIENTS. Published as an immediate @Component(service=CellarCipher.class): where this bundle is provisioned, CodecCellar and the ScenarioCellar pick it up over the built-in PassphraseCellarCipher; where it is absent, the passphrase mono-recipient stand-in stays. type= runtime — a runtime mechanism activated in-framework, exporting nothing (the seam it fills is seed-broker-port's). See docs/architecture/atlas/cellar-secrets.adoc.
